blocks.explanation:
Yahan ek taraf \(\cos(2x - 1)\) hai aur doosri taraf seedhi line \(\frac{x}{5}\). Cosine aur line ko barabar karne wali equation ka koi seedha formula nahi, is liye graph se hal karenge.
Diya kya hai? Equation aur interval \([0, \pi]\).
Find kya karna hai? Woh \(x\) jahan wave \(y = \cos(2x - 1)\) aur line \(y = \frac{x}{5}\) milte hain.
Plan: shakal samjhein, table banayein, graph kheenchein, crossing parhein, 2 decimal tak pakka karein aur check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\cos(2x - 1) = \frac{x}{5}\), \(x \in [0, \pi]\).
Maloom karna: interval ke saare roots.
Tareeqa: \(y = \cos(2x - 1)\) aur \(y = \frac{x}{5}\) ko ek hi axes par plot karenge; intersection points ke x-coordinates roots honge. Crossing dhoondne ke liye farq \(d = \cos(2x - 1) - \frac{x}{5}\) ka sign dekhenge.

Har graph ki shakal
\(y = \cos(2x - 1)\): amplitude 1 aur period \(\frac{2\pi}{2} = \pi\). Period (woh fasla jis ke baad graph apne aap ko dohrata hai) \(\pi\) hai, yani \([0, \pi]\) mein poori ek wave aati hai. Sab se ooncha (1) jab \(2x - 1 = 0\), yani \(x = 0.5\); sab se neecha (\(-1\)) jab \(2x - 1 = \pi\), yani \(x = \frac{\pi + 1}{2} \approx 2.07\). Dono kinaron par value \(\cos 1 \approx 0.54\) hai.
\(y = \frac{x}{5}\): origin se guzarne wali line, slope \(\frac{1}{5}\); 0 se barh kar \(\frac{\pi}{5} \approx 0.63\) tak jati hai.
Kyun: \(\cos(ax + b)\) ka period \(\frac{2\pi}{a}\) hota hai; yahan \(a = 2\). Is se pata chal gaya ke wave ek dafa neeche aa kar dobara ooper jayegi, to line ko do dafa kaat sakti hai. Yeh dekhna zaroori hai ke doosri dafa kaat'ti hai ya nahi.

Table of values (radians, 2 decimal)
\(x = 0\): \(\cos(2x - 1) = 0.54\), \(\frac{x}{5} = 0\), \(d = 0.54\)
\(x = 1\): \(0.54\), \(0.20\), \(d = 0.34\)
\(x = 1.5\): \(-0.42\), \(0.30\), \(d = -0.72\)
\(x = 2\): \(-0.99\), \(0.40\), \(d = -1.39\)
\(x = 3\): \(0.28\), \(0.60\), \(d = -0.32\)
\(x = \pi\): \(0.54\), \(0.63\), \(d = -0.09\)
Kyun: \(d\) ka sign sirf 1 aur 1.5 ke darmiyan badalta hai. \(x = \pi\) ke qareeb wave dobara ooper aati hai lekin sirf 0.54 tak pohanchti hai, jab ke line pehle hi 0.63 par hai. Wave line tak pohanch hi nahi paati, is liye doosri crossing interval ke andar nahi hoti.
Dhyan dein: Sirf shakal dekh kar 'do crossings' maan lena ghalti hai; kinare wali value zaroor check karein.

Graph bana kar intersection parhein
Figure mein wave neeche jate hue line ko sirf ek dafa kaat'ti hai:
\[x \approx 1.17\]
Kyun: \([0, \pi]\) mein ek hi intersection point hai, is liye ek hi root hai.

2 decimal tak pakka karein
\(d(1.165) = +0.006\), \(d(1.175) = -0.016\)
Kyun: 1.165 aur 1.175 par sign mukhtalif hain, yani root in dono ke beech hai (asal mein \(1.1676\ldots\)), aur round karne par 1.17 banta hai.

Tasdeeq
\(x = 1.17\): \(\cos(2(1.17) - 1) = \cos 1.34 = 0.229\)
\(\frac{1.17}{5} = 0.234\)
Kyun: Dono sides takreeban barabar hain (farq sirf 0.005), jo 2 decimal wale jawab ke liye bilkul theek hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(x \approx 1.17\) radians
Yani \([0, \pi]\) mein sirf ek root hai.

answer_figure.alt: Graph of y = cos(2x minus 1) (blue wave: 0.54 at x = 0, peak 1 at x = 0.5, lowest minus 1 near x = 2.07, back to 0.54 at x = pi) and the line y = x/5 (pink, from 0 at the origin to about 0.63 at x = pi). They meet once, at x about 1.17, marked with a dashed line to the x-axis.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(x = 1.16\) radians likha hai. Root asal mein \(x = 1.1676\ldots\) hai (\(d(1.165) = +0.006\), \(d(1.175) = -0.016\)), jo round ho kar \(1.17\) banta hai. \(x = 1.16\) par dono sides \(0.248\) aur \(0.232\) hain, barabar nahi. Sahi jawab: \(x \approx 1.17\) radians.
